kingdom_centre.name: Kingdom Centre
kingdom_centre.price_text: Sky Bridge ticket — check price on the day
kingdom_centre.hours: Sky Bridge usually open daily; check on the day
kingdom_centre.tip: Go up to the Sky Bridge near sunset for the best view over the city.

diriyah.name: Diriyah
diriyah.price_text: Entry to the district is usually free; some sites charge — check on the day
diriyah.hours: Outdoor areas open daily; site hours vary
diriyah.tip: Come in the evening when the mud-brick walls are lit and the restaurants open.

masmak.name: Masmak Fortress
masmak.hours: Sat–Thu mornings and evenings; closed Friday — check on the day
masmak.tip: Small museum inside a restored mud-brick fort; allow under an hour.

turaif.name: At-Turaif District
turaif.price_text: Ticket price varies by event — check on the day
turaif.hours: Check on the day; often evening hours
turaif.tip: This is the UNESCO-listed heart of Diriyah — pair it with a Diriyah evening visit.

national_museum.name: National Museum of Saudi Arabia
national_museum.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
national_museum.hours: Closed Friday mornings; check on the day
national_museum.tip: Start on the upper floor for pre-Islamic history, then work down.

al_hokair_land.name: Al Hokair Land
al_hokair_land.price_text: Ride tickets sold separately — check on the day
al_hokair_land.hours: Usually evenings; seasonal — check on the day
al_hokair_land.tip: A family theme park; go after sunset when it is cooler and rides run.

kabsa.name: Kabsa
kabsa.price_text: ≈ SAR 30–80 per plate depending on meat
kabsa.hours: Lunch and dinner at most kabsa restaurants
kabsa.tip: The national rice-and-meat dish — try it at a local kabsa house, shared from one big plate.

king_fahd_stadium.name: King Fahd International Stadium
king_fahd_stadium.price_text: Match tickets vary — check on the day
king_fahd_stadium.hours: Only on match or event days
king_fahd_stadium.tip: Visit only if there is a match or event; check the fixture list first.

souq_al_zal.name: Souq Al Zal
souq_al_zal.hours: Open daily, busiest in the evening
souq_al_zal.tip: Old-style market for carpets, antiques and souvenirs — bargain politely.

souq_market.name: Traditional food and spice market
souq_market.tip: Buy dates, spices and Arabic coffee to take home.

sky_viewpoint.name: Rooftop viewpoint over Olaya
sky_viewpoint.price_text: Café or ticket price — check on the day
sky_viewpoint.tip: A high café or tower deck gives the best skyline photos at dusk.

edge_walk.name: Jeddah Street / Tahlia evening walk
edge_walk.tip: Walk the café-lined streets after dark when the city comes out.

city_tour.name: Half-day city tour
city_tour.tip: Covers Masmak, the National Museum and Diriyah in one go — good for a first day.

desert_tour.name: Edge of the World day trip
desert_tour.price_text: ≈ SAR 250–500 per person with 4x4 and pickup
desert_tour.tip: Cliff-top desert views about two hours from the city — book a guided 4x4.

wadi_walk.name: Wadi Hanifah walk
wadi_walk.tip: Green valley park for an easy walk or picnic away from traffic.
wadi_walk.best: Morning or late afternoon, cooler months

dq_walk.name: Diplomatic Quarter walk
dq_walk.tip: Quiet, leafy streets and embassies — a calm contrast to downtown.
